ja.title: 免疫の老化は採血で読めるか。血中蛋白から細胞の状態を探る
ja.summary: 免疫老化研究の細胞状態・蛋白代理指標・健康転帰を分けて読む。独自の仮想計算で、細胞比の回収数依存と、同じ相関でも変わる測定尺度を示す。

en.title: Can blood proteins read immune aging? From cell states to proxy measurements
en.summary: Cell recovery and protein-proxy errors answer different questions. Two numerical examples examine an immune-aging study without claiming clinical validation.
en.seo_title: Immune aging: cell states and plasma-protein proxies
en.seo_description: Cell recovery and protein-proxy errors answer different questions. Two numerical examples examine an immune-aging study without claiming clinical validation.

english.title: Can blood proteins read immune aging? From cell states to proxy measurements
english.summary: Two original hypothetical examples show capture-depth uncertainty in cell ratios and affine shifts in protein proxy scores. Empirical reports are distinguished from measurement arithmetic.
